manifest.selection: Sixteen wholly fresh complete mappings were frozen before tokenizer import or count exposure, balanced eight per registered stratum over eight paired domains. Counts, totals, rule names, and limiters are absent from the routed original; every finite cell will be filed regardless of direction.
manifest.method: Under tiktoken 0.14.0, compute tokens(ainglish)-tokens(english) for every complete pair in cl100k_base and o200k_base. Compute an equal-item mean for each registered stratum within each tokenizer, combine strata with equal registered weight, then use the maximum tokenizer mean as the least-favourable headline. Report all cells and file regardless of sign or agreement.
